en.title: Radar Calibration in Kuantan: ACC or Lane Keep Off? | AP Car
en.description: Radar calibration in Kuantan: why ACC and lane keep switch off, the signs, and how AP Car aims the radar or camera in its own bay, then road tests.
en.h1: Radar calibration in Kuantan: ACC or lane keep switched off?
en.lead: Looking for radar calibration in Kuantan? It usually starts with one thing: ACC or lane keep has switched off. Here is what that means and what we do.
en.answer: When the front radar or camera is out of line, ACC and lane keep switch off until it is aimed again. We read the code, aim it in our bay with Autel / MaxiSys equipment, then road test.
en.prefill: Hi AP Car, my ACC / lane keep is switched off and I need radar calibration. Car model:
en.excerpt: The signs, why the system switches off, and our 4 steps.

list: ACC or lane keep switched off
After bumper, radar or windscreen work
Lane keep pulls the wrong way

p: ACC, lane keep (LKAS), lane departure (LDW) and pre-crash use a front radar and camera that must point exactly right.
When a code such as "misalignment millimeter wave radar" appears, the system switches off until it is aimed again.

steps: Target stand placed for the car
Radar or camera aiming on the scanner
ACC and lane keep checked on the road

jobs: Honda Civic Type R (FK8): ADAS calibration + road test
Honda Civic (2017, Japan): radar aiming after code P2583-76
Honda N-Box: ACC and lane-keep camera aiming
Toyota Alphard: pre-crash system malfunction, ADAS calibration + road test

faqs.q: Do I need calibration after bumper or windscreen work?
faqs.a: If ACC or lane keep stops working after bumper, radar or windscreen work, the radar or camera may need aiming. WhatsApp us the car model and what you see.
Yes. Every calibration we post ends with a road test.
Our posts show Honda and Toyota jobs. The procedure depends on the car, so WhatsApp the model first and we will tell you.

ms.h1: Kalibrasi ADAS Kuantan: ACC atau LKAS tak berfungsi?
ms.lead: Kalibrasi ADAS Kuantan biasanya bermula dengan satu masalah: ACC atau LKAS tiba-tiba tak berfungsi. Ini maksudnya dan apa yang kami buat.
ms.answer: Bila radar atau kamera hadapan tak sejajar, ACC dan LKAS berhenti sehingga dikalibrasi semula. Kami baca kod, kalibrasi di bengkel kami dengan peralatan Autel / MaxiSys, kemudian uji jalan.
ms.prefill: Hi AP Car, ACC / LKAS kereta saya tak berfungsi, saya perlukan kalibrasi ADAS. Model kereta:
ms.excerpt: Tanda-tanda, kenapa sistem berhenti, dan 4 langkah kami.

list: Selepas kerja bampar, radar atau cermin depan
Lane keep tarik ke arah salah

p: ACC, LKAS, LDW dan sistem pre-crash bergantung pada radar dan kamera hadapan yang mesti tepat.
Bila keluar kod seperti "misalignment millimeter wave radar", sistem berhenti sehingga dikalibrasi semula.

steps: ACC dan LKAS diuji di jalan

jobs: Honda Civic Type R (FK8): kalibrasi ADAS + uji jalan
Honda Civic (2017, Jepun): radar aiming selepas kod P2583-76
Honda N-Box: kalibrasi kamera ACC dan LKAS
Toyota Alphard: pre-crash system malfunction, kalibrasi ADAS + uji jalan

faqs.q: Perlu kalibrasi selepas kerja bampar atau cermin depan?
faqs.a: Jika ACC atau LKAS tak berfungsi selepas kerja bampar, radar atau cermin depan, radar atau kamera mungkin perlu dikalibrasi. WhatsApp model kereta dan apa yang anda nampak.
Ada. Setiap kalibrasi yang kami kongsi diakhiri dengan uji jalan.
Hantaran kami tunjuk kerja Honda dan Toyota. Prosedur ikut kereta, jadi WhatsApp model dulu.

zh.h1: 关丹雷达校准：ACC 或车道保持失灵怎么办？
zh.lead: 来问关丹雷达校准的车主，通常都是同一个问题：ACC 或车道保持突然失灵。下面说明原因和我们的做法。
zh.answer: 前雷达或摄像头一旦偏移，ACC 和车道保持就会暂停，直到重新校准。我们先读故障码，在店里用 Autel／MaxiSys 设备标定，再上路测试。

一旦出现 "misalignment millimeter wave radar" 之类的故障码，系统会暂停，直到重新校准。
